title: CLIP 漂移连续触发次数

standard.summary: 连续多少步 CLIP 漂移超过危险阈值才触发干预。默认 5。
standard.effect: 防止偶发的 CLIP 分数波动误触发干预，要求持续异常才响应。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 5 适合大多数场景。训练 batch 较小时 CLIP 分数波动更大，可适当增大到 8~10。
standard.avoidWhen: 不建议设为 1（太容易误触发）。

standard_en.summary: How many consecutive steps CLIP drift must exceed the danger threshold before an intervention fires. Default 5.
standard_en.effect: Keeps an occasional CLIP-score fluctuation from triggering an intervention -- only a sustained anomaly gets a response.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default 5 fits most cases. With a small training batch the CLIP score swings more, so 8 to 10 is reasonable.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not set it to 1 -- far too easy to trigger by accident.

advanced.principle: 维护连续超阈值计数器，正常步归零，超阈值递增，达到阈值才触发干预。
advanced.tradeoffs: 值越大越稳健，但检测延迟越长；实际触发时已经连续多步异常，可能已有一定偏移。

advanced_en.principle: Maintains a consecutive-over-threshold counter: reset to zero on normal steps, incremented on over-threshold steps; intervention fires only when the count reaches the threshold.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Larger values are more robust but add detection latency; by the time it fires, several consecutive steps have already been abnormal and some drift may have accumulated.
